title: Sam Altman revealed AGI is 2 years away

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Sam Altman just said AGI is only 2 years away — and it’s changing everything.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just tech talk — it’s a game-changer for the next decade.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AGI is artificial general intelligence — a machine that thinks like a human.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Altman mentioned breakthroughs in neural networks that learn on their own.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Everyone from workers to CEOs will need to adapt to this new era.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: We’re not just approaching AI — we’re approaching a revolution.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think we’ll be able to do in 2 years? Follow for more.

caption_text: Sam Altman revealed AGI is 2 years away
